He serves as the biology teacher of [[Naranja Academy]]{{sup/9|S}}/[[Uva Academy]]{{sup/9|V}}, as well as the homeroom teacher for the {{wp|general studies|general studies}} track. Along with the World Pokémon Ecological Society, he is known for his research on [[convergent species]]. ==In the core series games== ===Role=== ====Pokémon Scarlet and Violet==== Jacq is a biology teacher who works at [[Naranja Academy]]{{sup/9|S}}/[[Uva Academy]]{{sup/9|V}}. He is also the {{player}}'s homeroom teacher, as well as the developer of the [[Pokédex]] app for the [[Rotom Phone]]. Although he is very well-versed in his field, he is somewhat airheaded, and is sometimes lost in his own research.[https://scarletviolet.pokemon.com/en-us/characters/jacq/ Jacq — Pokémon Scarlet and Pokémon Violet | Official Website] Jacq also participates in the [[Academy Ace Tournament]]. Upon the player completing more and more of the Pokédex, he grants them various rewards, culminating in a [[Shiny Charm]] after the player has registered all 400 Pokémon entries. ====The Teal Mask==== Jacq is the teacher who informs the player they have been selected to attend the field trip to [[Kitakami]]. After the player begins their orienteering activities there, they can find Jacq at [[Reveler's Road]], where he will invite them to a [[picnic]] and give them an {{pkmn|Egg}} containing a random [[Sinnoh first partner Pokémon]]. Following that, he will remain at Reveler's Road, where he will volunteer to evaluate their [[List of Pokémon by Kitakami Pokédex number|Kitakami Pokédex]] and reward the player with a [[Glimmering Charm]] for completing it. ====Other appearances==== Jacq and [[Professor Willow]] discussed the Pokémon {{p|Gimmighoul}} in a promotional video for [[Pokémon Scarlet and Violet]], uploaded on November 6, 2022. Jacq was the one who named Gimmighoul's {{form|Gimmighoul|Chest Form}}."[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-nzi0S3NGzg Where are these mysterious coins coming from? 🤔 | Pokémon Scarlet and Pokémon Violet]." [https://www.youtube.com/c/pokemon The Official Pokémon YouTube Channel]. {{color2|fff|Pokémon GO|GO}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Jacq/Quotes}} ==In animation== [[File:Jacq anime.png|thumb|250px|Jacq in {{aniseries|HZ}}]] ===''Pokémon Horizons: The Series''=== Jacq first appeared in ''[[HZ046|Welcome to Naranja Academy!]]''. He was first seen at [[Naranja Academy]], where he met [[Liko]], [[Roy]], and [[Dot]]. He requested that while Liko and her friends participate in the [[Tera Training]] course, they also take photos and make reports on any [[wild Pokémon]] they would encounter while traveling. Jacq was mentioned by [[Clavell]] in ''[[HZ050|Trending Terastallization! Dance, Dance, Quaxly!]]''. During Clavell's assessment of Liko, Roy, and Dot's progress in Tera Training, he mentioned that Jacq saw a lot of potential in the young Trainers. In ''[[HZ055|Showdown! The Paldea Elite Four]]'', Jacq accompanied Clavell in welcoming the students back to the academy and promising to give each of their reports a good read. He later joined the students in watching the [[Elite Four Tag Battle]]. In ''[[HZ101|Terastallization vs. Mega Evolution!]]'', Jacq was asked by Clavell to follow Dot's research and report on [[Laquium]]. Intrigued by the subject, he decided to participate in the research alongside the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]]. In ''[[HZ120|Dot and Penny's Top-Secret Mission!]]'', Penny revealed to Dot that she will leave Jacq in charge of researching the data they recovered from the [[Exceed]] Museum server. Days later, in [[HZ126]], Jacq met with Clavell, [[Geeta]], {{an|Nemona}}. [[Penny]] and the Rising Volt Tacklers to discuss the information Dot and Penny had gathered. While he was concerned about the data, he pointed out that the way the information was collected might prevent public opinion from accepting it naturally. ====Character==== Jacq has a friendly and cheerful personality, and is always keen to help students and encourage them in their endeavors. Jacq's research is considered a benchmark, being used by [[Briar]] in ''[[HZ119|Don't Give Up, Crocalor!]]'' as a reference to help her understand more about {{TP|Liko|Terapagos}} and the [[Laquium]]. In the past, Jacq was a Pokémon ecology researcher alongside [[Clavell]], but due to Clavell's strictness towards his work, Jacq was often reprimanded. ====Pokémon==== =====Traveling with===== {| width="75%" | {{ActivePoké|||nick=Rotom Phone|Jacq Rotom Phone.png|electric|ghost|link=Rotom Phone}} | |} ====Voice actors==== {{vatable|color={{violet color}}|bordercolor={{violet color dark}} |ja=畠中 祐 ''[[Tasuku Hatanaka]]'' |en=[[Alejandro Saab]] |ar=عماد فغالي ''Imad Feghaly'' |zh_yue=張添勝 ''Tim Cheung'' |nl=Roben Mitchell |he=קובי ליקורמן ''Kobi Likverman'' |it=Mosè Singh |pl=Jan Piotrowski |es_la=Mario Heras |es_eu=Juanqui Manrique }} ====Artwork==== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{violet color dark}}; background: #{{violet color}}; font-size:80%;" |- |style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{violet color dark}}; background: #{{violet color light}};"| [[File:Jacq HZ.png|100px]] |style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{violet color dark}}; background: #{{violet color light}};"| [[File:Jacq Anime Expression Sheet.png|250px]] |- style="color:#fff;" |Official artwork of Jacq from

''{{color2|fff|Pokémon Horizons: The Series}}'' |} ===Pokémon: Paldean Winds=== [[File:Jacq Paldean Winds.png|thumb|250px|Jacq in [[Pokémon: Paldean Winds]]]] Jacq briefly appeared in ''[[PPW04|Breathe Together]]'', during [[Ohara]], [[Aliquis]], and [[Hohma]]'s video presenting [[Naranja Academy]]. {{-}} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Salvatore Jacq Raifort Adventures.png|thumb|220px|Jacq in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] Jacq debuted in ''[[PASV01|Speeding! Paldea's Prince of Speed!!]]''. He was first seen in the [[Uva Academy]] staff room, attacking someone he believed to be an intruder, only to find it was a student named [[Violet Lang|Violet]]. Once the misunderstanding was cleared up, Violet's talking [[Rotom Phone]], [[Old Roto]], asked Jacq to install a [[Pokédex]] app onto it, which he accepted. Once Jacq found that Violet was looking through the student registry, he attempted to reprimand the boy, only for Violet to escape. Later, [[Clavell]] gathered Jacq and the other teachers in order to inform them of Violet's backstory and explain his behavior. In ''[[PASV12|Stream! Iono Zone!!]]'', Jacq, along with [[Salvatore]] and [[Raifort]], agreed to take Clavell's place in [[Iono]]'s [[Gym]] Test. {{-}} ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Jacq |pkmn=Farigiraf |type1=Normal |type2=Psychic |img=Jacq Farigiraf Adventures.png |epnum=PASV01 |epname=Speeding! Paldea's Prince of Speed!! |desc={{p|Farigiraf}} is Jacq's only known Pokémon. It was first used to keep [[Violet Lang|Violet]] in place when Jacq mistook him for an intruder. Farigiraf's only known move is {{m|Confusion}}.}} ==In the TCG== [[File:JacqScarletViolet250.jpg|200px|thumb|Special illustration rare Jacq]] {{main|Jacq (Scarlet & Violet 175)}} '''Jacq''' was introduced as a {{TCG|Supporter card}} in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] during the English Scarlet & Violet Series (the Japanese Scarlet & Violet Era). It was first released in the Japanese {{TCG|Scarlet ex}} expansion and the English {{TCG|Scarlet & Violet}} expansion, with artwork by [[GIDORA]]. An {{TCG|ultra rare}} print illustrated by the same artist, and a {{TCG|special illustration rare}} version of the card with artwork by [[Oswaldo KATO]] were released in the same sets. It lets players search their deck for up to two Evolution Pokémon, reveal them, and put them in their hand. Afterwards, the player shuffles their deck. {{-}} ==Trivia== * Jacq first appeared in Pokémon GO thirteen days before the release of Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, thus technically making him the second character to appear in the [[core series]] games after first appearing in a [[Spin-off Pokémon games|spin-off game]] (the first being [[Professor Burnet]]). However, he was first revealed in pre-release material for Pokémon Scarlet and Violet in August 2022, three months prior to his Pokémon GO appearance. * Jacq was intended to speak in the [https://wpes.pokemon.co.jp/en/ World Pokémon Ecological Society] mock seminar that showcased {{p|Wiglett}}, but he ran late and ended up unable to attend, according to an unnamed assistant. Despite this, Professor Willow mentions Jacq having spoken at the World Pokémon Ecological Society conference.'''[[Professor Willow/Quotes|Professor Willow]]''': "Oh—hello, Jacq! It was great hearing you speak at the World Pokémon Ecological Society conference the other day!" ({{g|GO}}) * In a prior version of Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, if the gift {{p|Riolu}} hatched from the {{pkmn|Egg}} from [[Riley]] is transferred from [[Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl|Pokémon Brilliant Diamond or Shining Pearl]] to Pokémon Scarlet or Violet, the game will state it was received from Jacq. * All of Jacq’s Pokémon represent the biomes of Paldea and Kitakami. ** Arcanine’s evolutionary line is found in rocky areas. ** Lurantis’ evolutionary line is found in forests and meadows. ** Swalot’s evolutionary line is found near urban areas. ** Mudsdale’s evolutionary line is found in mountains and swamps. ** Slowbro’s evolutionary line is found near rivers and beaches. ** Farigiraf’s and Victreebel’s evolutionary lines are found in prairies. *Jacq's Japanese name is the same name as [[Zinnia]]'s English name. ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{violet color}}; border:3px solid #{{violet color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{violet color light}}; color:#FFFFFF" | Language ! style="background:#{{violet color light}}; color:#FFFFFF" | Name ! style="background:#{{violet color light}}; color:#FFFFFF" | Origin |- | Japanese | ジニア ''Zinnia'' | From ''{{wp|Zinnia}}'' and ジニアス ''jiniasu'' (genius) |- | English, French,
